description: Shows how the agent under test is doing. With a project only: a roll-up of the project (suites all passing, partly failing, all failing, never run, running now) and one row per suite with its all-time pass rate and average score, which cover every run the suite has had. With a project and status: the results with that outcome across the whole project, for example every failed scenario, newest first. For a phone caller project the suite rows carry the latest call's outcome and score instead. With a suite: one row per scenario (chat: its latest attempt; voice and phone: every call) with outcome, score from 0 to 100 and, where recorded, a short reason. Outcomes are passed, failed, partial, errored (the test could not be carried out), running, inconclusive and completed (finished but not judged). For an image analyser project: its image analyses with a quality score. Each row carries a result reference for agent_testing_explain_result. Covers chat, voice, phone caller (including IVR) and image analyser projects.

agent.description: Chat agent name or ID, for a project with several chat agents.

includeHistory.description: Chat suites: include earlier attempts of each scenario, not just the latest (default false).

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (default 50 suites, 25 results).

project.description: Project name (all or part of it) or ID.

scenario.description: With suite: only the results of this scenario (ID or part of its title). Use with includeHistory for its past attempts.

sort.description: Order of the rows: by pass rate or score, or by most recent result.

status.description: Only results with this outcome. Without suite it lists them across the project (running lists the suites running now).

suite.description: Suite name (all or part of it) or ID. Gives one row per scenario of this suite.

name: agent_testing_get_results
title: Get Agent Testing Results
